title_seed: Direct Study 與 Full Text 是兩個數字
central_problem: 為什麼 direct-study discovery 很高，qualifying full-text coverage 卻仍然很低？
reader_takeaway: 找到回答問題的研究，與取得可驗證全文，是兩個獨立的 admission gates。

known_at_the_time.fact: direct-study discovery V3 reached 9/10 case coverage while qualifying-full-text coverage remained 2/10。
the run used bounded endpoint discovery, body-first HTML extraction and PDF fallback without manual rescue or content rerun。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: zero-direct cases activated a bounded topic-anchored fallback only under the specified condition; direct-study counts and full-text counts stayed separate。

not_yet_available.fact: 9/10 direct-study coverage did not imply 9/10 qualifying artifacts or formal reports。

observed_failures.symptom: many direct studies still had abstract/non-qualifying acquisition states
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: lawful route availability, payload materialization, parser/identity and qualification remained limiting layers
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: do not enter Writer optimization while full-text gate is the first weak layer
observed_failures.later_resolution: V5 kept the content gate false and targeted admission/materialization rather than prompt tuning

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: The fresh V3 cohort reached 9/10 direct-study discovery and 2/10 qualifying full-text coverage.
tests_and_metrics.result: discovery and evidence metrics diverged; no Writer/replay rescue was counted

engineering_decisions.decision: 把 direct-study discovery、payload acquisition、qualifying full text 與 Writer calls 做成不同 cohort metrics。

architecture_state.state: retrieval → direct-study classification → legal full-text route → materialization/qualification → canonical admission

safe_public_facts.fact: 搜尋找到研究與取得可引用全文之間，可能隔著一整條法律、格式、身分與 parser pipeline。

retrospective_notes.note: 下一日會顯示 post-closure audit 如何重新檢查 canonical binding 與 budget fan-out；不要在本日先下那個結論。

publication_risks: 不可把 9/10 讀成 9/10 可發布。
不要公開 paper raw payload 或未授權全文。
